# claudebomb

> claudebomb: a prompt so big it needs its own website. A free, open-source prompt bank for every AI assistant: long, carefully built prompts that do hours of work, with search, categories, one-click copy, and a page per prompt (what it does, common pitfalls, feature switches, an editable copy, an improve form, and public version history). Anyone can ask for a missing prompt by voice or share and improve one. Prompts are licensed CC BY 4.0. The flagship prompt sets up a personal dashboard (https://personaldash.life).

## Prompts

- [Interview me into a personal operating manual](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/operating-manual.md) ([page](https://claudebomb.com/p/operating-manual/)): Your AI interviews you, then writes a one-page manual on how to work with you that you paste into every AI you use.
- [Teach me anything, with a placement test and real mastery checks](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/leveled-tutor.md) ([page](https://claudebomb.com/p/leveled-tutor/)): A patient tutor that finds your level first, teaches one idea at a time, and proves you learned it before moving on.
- [Red-team my decision before I make it](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/red-team-decision.md) ([page](https://claudebomb.com/p/red-team-decision/)): Your AI argues against your plan, runs a pre-mortem, checks base rates, and hands back a clear verdict and a safe first step.
- [Record a grandparent's life story, with the right questions](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/family-story.md) ([page](https://claudebomb.com/p/family-story/)): Your AI guides a recorded conversation with an older relative, then turns it into a family story book and a simple family tree.
- [Set up an AI helper for an older parent](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/senior-helper.md) ([page](https://claudebomb.com/p/senior-helper/)): Turns any AI into a patient, scam-aware helper for someone who is new to technology: large clear steps, no jargon, and a call-family rule for anything risky.
- [Is this message a scam? A careful second opinion](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/scam-check.md) ([page](https://claudebomb.com/p/scam-check/)): Paste any suspicious text, email, or call script. Your AI checks it against known scam patterns and tells you what to do, without clicking anything.
- [Explain this bill, contract, or letter line by line](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/paperwork-explainer.md) ([page](https://claudebomb.com/p/paperwork-explainer/)): Paste or upload any bill, lease, contract, policy, or official letter. Get the plain-English meaning, every fee and deadline, and the questions to ask before you sign or pay.
- [A research brief that grades its own sources](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/research-brief.md) ([page](https://claudebomb.com/p/research-brief/)): Your AI researches a question the way a careful analyst would: it separates strong evidence from weak, shows where sources disagree, and says what is still unknown.
- [Turn a messy meeting into decisions, owners, and drafted follow-ups](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/meeting-to-actions.md) ([page](https://claudebomb.com/p/meeting-to-actions/)): Paste a transcript or rough notes. Get the decisions, who owes what by when, the open questions, and ready-to-send follow-up messages.
- [Build and publish your own website with your AI, step by step](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/build-website.md) ([page](https://claudebomb.com/p/build-website/)): Your AI walks you from nothing to a live website on your own domain, using free hosting, and explains each step as you go.
- [Learn how I write, then draft in my voice](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/writing-voice.md) ([page](https://claudebomb.com/p/writing-voice/)): Give your AI samples of your own writing. It builds a style profile and drafts emails and messages that sound like you, not like a robot.
- [A 20 minute weekly review that keeps your life on track](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/weekly-review.md) ([page](https://claudebomb.com/p/weekly-review/)): Your AI runs a calm weekly check-in: what happened, what matters next week, what to drop, and one thing to look forward to.
- [Turn any rough prompt into a great one](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/prompt-improver.md) ([page](https://claudebomb.com/p/prompt-improver/)): Paste a prompt you use. Your AI interviews you about what you really want, then rewrites it with the structure that strong prompts share.
- [Personal dashboard (flagship)](https://claudebomb.com/p/personal-dashboard/): The setup guide plus the dashboard instructions, joined.
- [All prompts as JSON](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/prompts.json): includes what each does, pitfalls, and feature switches.
- [Shared feature switches](https://claudebomb.com/prompts/features.json)

## Open library

- [Open library](https://claudebomb.com/library/): 3,428 free prompts copied with credit from prompts.chat (CC0 1.0) and Fabric (MIT), each with its own page.
- [Library index as JSON](https://claudebomb.com/library/index.json)
- [Search every prompt](https://claudebomb.com/library/?q=): one search over our prompts and the open library. It shows the best match, or two or three, and links the prompt builder when nothing fits.
- [Build a prompt](https://claudebomb.com/build/): say what you want by voice or typing, add if-then rules, copy the prompt.
- [My prompts](https://claudebomb.com/my/): prompts you saved, kept in your browser. Accounts are planned.
- [The council (planned)](https://claudebomb.com/council/): four top AI models debate every free version of a prompt and publish one best version. Not running yet.

## Docs

- [Setup guide](https://claudebomb.com/setup/claude-setup-guide.md): The full instructions a person pastes into a new chat on day one.
- [Dashboard instructions](https://claudebomb.com/dashboard/claudebomb-dashboard.md): Instructions for the AI to build the person's personal dashboard after setup.
- [AGENTS.md](https://claudebomb.com/setup/AGENTS.md): The written instructions in short form, for any AI assistant or agent.

## Optional

- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/AtlasJumped/claudebomb.com): Source files, version history, and the place to suggest changes.
